name: io.github.nightmoose/contractgate
title: AISchemaGate and DataContractGate
description: AISchemaGate validates and repairs structured LLM output against a contract, plus DataContractGate.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: AISchemaGate validates and repairs structured LLM output against a contract, plus DataContractGate data contracts. LLM guardrails for structured output, alongside JSON Schema and Pydantic validation. Repair uses the contract violations from that check (min, max, pattern, enum, compliance_mode). DataContractGate also validates ingest, including ODCS v3.1 and v3.2, and lists quarantine.
